properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 in the dev toolchain: @types/secp256k1 and secp256k1 native package metadata in package-lock.json (transitive deps of the old ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 via ethereumjs-util, dev-only) plus @noble/curves secp256k1 usage in ECDSA.test.js:252 to assert high-s signature rejection. properties.name: pqs:context

Available in the dev toolchain; no application call site in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSASigningKey test-key factory (test/helpers/signers.js:102-126): generateKeyPairSync('rsa', {modulusLength: 2048}) plus privateEncrypt (PKCS#1 v1.5, SHA-256 digest) to produce signatures the SignerRSA/RSA.sol contracts verify. RSA-2048, quantum-vulnerable; test-only, not shipped with the library.

components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (at least Node.js 22.12)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Release CI workflow helper (scripts/release/workflow/state.js) queries registry.npmjs.com via Node's global fetch on default TLS settings — no explicit cipher list, group list or min version. Changeable here. Node ≥22.12 basis: default TLS 1.3 via OpenSSL 3.x; note the post-quantum hybrid X25519MLKEM768 group only became a default at Node 22.13/23.4, so the actual CI runner version decides PQ capability of this session. Release tooling only, not part of the shipped library.
